summary: Iteration 2: tested ADMIN_EMAILS lockdown + per-business analytics deep-dive. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests pass (added 11 new tests across TestAdminBusinessAnalytics and TestAdminEmailsLockdown). New GET /api/admin/analytics/business/{id}?days=N endpoint returns correct shape, 404 on missing biz, 403 on non-admin, 401 on unauth, and timeline length always equals days for 7/30/90. Generated business_view/website_click/phone_click/directions_click events via /api/analytics/track and confirmed totals + today's timeline row reflect them. Frontend: deep-dive page renders name, image, 4 metric cards, recharts area chart (business-analytics-chart), owner snippet (business-analytics-snippet), and all three range buttons; clicking range-7 hits API with days=7 and gets timeline length 7; admin-analytics-{id} icon in businesses tab + admin-analytics-row-{id} in analytics tab both navigate to /admin/business/{id}. Unauthenticated visit redirects to /admin/login.
action_items: Main agent: review the two App.js bugs the testing agent had to patch to unblock testing (see updated_files). The route /admin/business/:id was MISSING (despite review-request claim that it was added), and the file had a stray garbage line 't App;' on line 42 that prevented the frontend from compiling at all. Both fixed in /app/frontend/src/App.js. Please verify the fix matches your intent and consider why the original commit went out broken (likely a bad copy-paste).

Optional cleanup (already noted iter-1): CategoryDetailPage was supposed to de-dupe business_view in this iteration — quick spot-check shows the tracking call still fires once per business card on every CategoryDetailPage render; verify the de-dupe actually landed (review request claimed it did).
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKER (fixed by testing agent): /app/frontend/src/App.js line 42 had a stray 't App;' token after 'export default App;' — caused babel-loader SyntaxError and the entire frontend was serving the CRA error overlay. Removed.

BLOCKER (fixed by testing agent): /app/frontend/src/App.js was missing <Route path="/admin/business/:id" element={<AdminBusinessAnalyticsPage />} />. The import was present, the page component exists, but the route was never registered, so navigation fell through to the catch-all HomePage. Route added.

ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist enforcement in /auth/session is correct: on every login the role is re-derived from the allowlist and demoted to 'user' if email is no longer allowed (server.py lines 333-338). Cannot exercise full flow without a real Emergent session_id but the code path is correct and require_admin still rejects non-admins (verified via 403 tests).

Per-business analytics endpoint uses ISO timestamp string for the since-filter (since = isoformat()) and groups by $substr of timestamp[0:10] — works because ISO-8601 timestamps are lexicographically sortable, but a real $dateTrunc/$dateFromString would be more robust if timestamps ever get written without a normalized 'Z' suffix.

Endpoint returns totals as an ALL-TIME aggregate but timeline is days-bounded — this is intentional but the UI labels should make this clear to the operator viewing the page (currently the metric cards do not disambiguate 'total' vs 'in selected range').

AdminBusinessAnalyticsPage error UI uses data-testid='business-analytics-error' but a 401/403 on /api/admin/analytics/business/{id} causes the page's api interceptor to redirect to /admin/login before the error UI ever renders — that's why the no-auth check found url=/admin/login and no error banner. Behavior is acceptable but worth a comment in the page component.

rca of the issue: Found two frontend BLOCKER bugs at start of testing: (1) /app/frontend/src/App.js line 42 contained a stray 'export default App;' followed by 't App;' — a clear typo/copy-paste artifact from the main agent's edit. webpack reported 'Module build failed ... SyntaxError: Missing semicolon (42:1)' and the entire SPA served the CRA error overlay. (2) The /admin/business/:id route the main agent claimed to add was actually never added — the AdminBusinessAnalyticsPage import was present but the <Route> registration was missing, so any navigation to /admin/business/<id> fell through to the wildcard route and rendered HomePage. Mitigation: testing agent removed the typo line and added the missing <Route path='/admin/business/:id' element={<AdminBusinessAnalyticsPage />} />. After hot-reload, frontend compiled cleanly and all flows pass. Main agent should review and acknowledge.
